summary.title: Reach Around threat model
summary.description: STRIDE model for Reach Around issue 481. docs/security/threat-model.md is the source of truth. Mitigated requires a visible tested repository control; provider and planned controls remain Open.

data.name: Config and assets
data.description: Instance copy, images, styles, and overrides.

threats.title: T-10 and T-20 Shipped input confinement controls
threats.description: T-10 and T-20: Hostile configuration, assets, CSS, SVG, or templates could escape the shipped input confinement controls or steer an interpreter.
threats.mitigation: T-10 and T-20 shipped subset: src/reach_around/site applies the hardened loader, closed schema, confined reads, caps, allowlists, refusals, and sandboxing; tests/config/test_loader.py, tests/config/test_models.py, and tests/site/test_assets_security.py verify those controls.

threats.title: T-10 and T-20 Remaining build and image controls
threats.description: T-10 and T-20: Reserved names, whole-build output confinement, or image metadata could escape the intended publication boundary.
threats.mitigation: T-10 and T-20 remainder: add the missing reserved-name and whole-build confinement controls and tests, then decide and implement metadata handling for published images.

threats.title: T-08 Static page injection and framing controls
threats.description: T-08: Configured text or URLs could inject active content or permit framing in static pages.
threats.mitigation: T-08 shipped subset: src/reach_around/site builds escaped static pages with strict headers; tests/site/test_build.py, tests/site/test_headers_cache_rules.py, and tests/config/test_models.py verify escaping, security headers, framing, and URL rules.

threats.title: T-08 Worker private-response headers
threats.description: T-08: A private Worker response could be cached, sniffed, or leak its emailed-link URL through a referrer.
threats.mitigation: T-08 remainder: add Worker-set private-response headers, a no-referrer policy for the emailed-link page, and tests that prove both controls.

threats.title: T-03 Gated content crosses into public deploy
threats.description: T-03: A build, route, cache, store, or deploy mistake could disclose gated content or private exports.
threats.mitigation: T-03: Builder separation is tested in tests/site, but the deploy refusal, private Worker store, and complete authorization path are not all shipped.

threats.title: T-18 and T-11 Audience or terms policy bypass
threats.description: T-18 and T-11: An override or new writer could publish data outside its allowed audience or platform terms.
threats.mitigation: T-18 and T-11: Build one audience projection, require expiring approvals, and test every surface before adding another output.

threats.title: T-09 Supply-chain compromise
threats.description: T-09: A compromised dependency or automation action could alter a release artifact.
threats.mitigation: T-09: pinned automation and lock files are partial controls. Add the missing local supply-chain invariant tests, install-script refusal, SBOM, provenance, and published-artifact verification. Provider-backed controls remain Open.

threats.title: T-02 and T-19 Credential exposure or weak recovery
threats.description: T-02 and T-19: A workflow, log, or stolen credential could expose an unclear blast radius with no tested recovery.
threats.mitigation: T-02 and T-19: Add protected deploy separation, a name-only inventory, scope manifests, and a tested revocation runbook. Provider settings remain Open.

threats.title: T-45 and T-54 Deploy configuration and budget controls
threats.description: T-45 and T-54: A placeholder or hostile repository variable could rewrite the deploy configuration, or raised budgets could exhaust the account allowance.
threats.mitigation: T-45 and T-54: Fail-closed variable checks and a budget step in the deploy workflow, verified in tests/test_deploy_config.py, tests/test_deploy_page_views.py and worker/test/kit/budgetcheck.test.ts. Provider-side limits stay unverified.

data.name: TB4 Visitor browser
data.description: Anonymous and gated requests are untrusted.

data.name: TB5 Edge and Worker
data.description: Routes share account and budget limits.

data.name: TB6 Data and providers
data.description: Stores and delivery hold data or spend.

data.name: Visitor or bot
data.description: Anonymous visitor, partner, or distributed sender.

data.name: Link page
data.description: Emits clicks and opens gate routes.

threats.title: T-05 and T-07 Polluted data and capacity exhaustion
threats.description: T-05 and T-07: Bots or distributed traffic can pollute counts and spend Worker, D1, logging, storage, or paid capacity.
threats.mitigation: T-05 and T-07: worker/src has tested guards, budgets, retention, and kill switches, but verification, provider-fronted limits, and final ceilings remain incomplete.

threats.title: T-04 and T-21 Token forgery or first-redeemer replay
threats.description: T-04 and T-21: A forged, forwarded, intercepted, or stolen bearer token could unlock the kit.
threats.mitigation: T-04 and T-21: Token helpers have worker/test coverage, but atomic redemption, live revocation, the binding policy, and deployment are incomplete.

threats.title: T-13 Alternate hostname exposure
threats.description: T-13: A default hostname, preview, DNS record, or missing Host check could expose an unintended endpoint.
threats.mitigation: T-13: Add and test the Host allowlist and explicit default-host setting, then record provider hostname and DNS checks.

threats.title: T-03 Gated content crosses into public deploy
threats.description: T-03: A build, route, cache, store, or deploy mistake could disclose gated content or private exports.
threats.mitigation: T-03: Builder separation is tested in tests/site, but the deploy refusal, private Worker store, and complete authorization path are not all shipped.

threats.title: T-01 Mail relay and quota exhaustion
threats.description: T-01: Anonymous requests could send unwanted mail or consume the provider quota.
threats.mitigation: T-01: Require fixed delivery, Turnstile, body limits, budgets, and a fail-closed outage choice before provider-backed mail ships.

threats.title: T-14 and T-63 to T-70 Alert or inquiry abuse
threats.description: T-14 and T-63 to T-70: An inquiry could bypass authorization, inject deceptive text, consume alert quota, leak publicly, or persist at a provider.
threats.mitigation: T-14 and T-63 to T-70: worker/src/kit, worker/src/alerts, worker/test/kit, and tests/site cover local validation, quotas, projection, and fixed responses. Provider retention and the undeployed gate keep the combined threat Open.

threats.title: T-12 and T-17 Lead retention misses copies
threats.description: T-12 and T-17: Lead data can outlive a promise or survive in exports, backups, provider recovery, alerts, or restores.
threats.mitigation: T-12 and T-17: worker/src/kit and src/reach_around/commands have tested D1 controls. Add the copy inventory, deletion registry, restore test, and provider roll-off record.

data.name: Live status endpoint and poller
data.description: Public read-only Live status response and the scheduled poller that feeds it.

threats.title: T-37 Live endpoint abuse
threats.description: T-37: The public status endpoint could be used to reach storage on every request, read from another site, or flood.
threats.mitigation: T-37: Cached response with no parameters, fixed method handling and a kill switch in worker/src/live.ts; worker/test/live/live.test.ts covers them. Deployed behavior is not yet observed.

threats.title: T-38 Stale live status
threats.description: T-38: The page could keep reporting live after the poller stops.
threats.mitigation: T-38: Stale data is served as unknown, verified in worker/test/live/live.test.ts. Deployed behavior is not yet observed.

threats.title: T-39 to T-40 Live page embeds and third-party code
threats.description: T-39 to T-40: Player frames and third-party embeds could widen the page policy or bring in compromised code.
threats.mitigation: T-39 to T-40: The Worker loads no third-party code; the page slice with click-to-load and named hosts is proposed and not built.

threats.title: T-41 to T-43 Live privacy, handle and secret handling
threats.description: T-41 to T-43: Viewer data, platform text, request-controlled handles or platform secrets could reach storage, responses or logs.
threats.mitigation: T-41 to T-43: Field-by-field responses, allowlisted parsing, config-pattern handles and env-only secrets in worker/src/live.ts; worker/test/live/live.test.ts verifies them. Deployed behavior is not yet observed.

threats.title: T-44 Failure code handling
threats.description: T-44: A failure code could carry free text into the public response or be trusted by the page.
threats.mitigation: T-44: Closed code list re-checked on read; worker/test/live/live.test.ts and tests/site/live_logic.mjs verify it. Deployed behavior is not yet observed.

data.name: Lead retention purge
data.description: Hourly job that deletes expired leads, and the local owner deletion command.

threats.title: T-46 Lead purge may not run
threats.description: T-46: Leads could outlive the promised window if the purge never runs or fails silently.
threats.mitigation: T-46: Hourly purge with a heartbeat in worker/test/kit/leadretention.test.ts; not deployed, so the schedule is unobserved.

threats.title: T-47 to T-50 Retention setting, quota, boundary and log handling
threats.description: T-47 to T-50: Bad retention settings, quota use, boundary errors or log content could keep or delete data wrongly.
threats.mitigation: T-47 to T-50: Strict setting parsing, bounded batches, strict age boundary and fixed log strings, verified in worker/test/kit/leadretention.test.ts.

threats.title: T-51 to T-53 Owner deletion command
threats.description: T-51 to T-53: The deletion command could be exposed over HTTP, leak the address it handles, or act on a tampered export.
threats.mitigation: T-51 to T-53: Local command with dry run default, masked output, bounded export reading and exact-match refusal in tests/test_leads_delete.py.

data.name: Live status KV
data.description: Cached platform live state and short-lived app tokens.

threats.title: T-06 Platform response leaks a secret
threats.description: T-06: A collector could log, cache, store, or export a secret embedded in a platform response.
threats.mitigation: T-06: Implement typed collector allowlists and synthetic sentinel tests before collectors ship.

data.name: Platform tokens
data.description: Read, OAuth, app, deploy, and Worker credentials.

threats.title: T-02 and T-19 Credential exposure or weak recovery
threats.description: T-02 and T-19: A workflow, log, or stolen credential could expose an unclear blast radius with no tested recovery.
threats.mitigation: T-02 and T-19: Add protected deploy separation, a name-only inventory, scope manifests, and a tested revocation runbook. Provider settings remain Open.

threats.title: T-15 Snapshot integrity failure
threats.description: T-15: A failed collector, hostile import, or token update failure could corrupt reports or exports.
threats.mitigation: T-15: Add source labels, stale markers, bounded validation, atomic updates, and spreadsheet neutralization with tests.

data.name: PDF and export pipeline
data.description: Builds private files from projected data.

threats.title: T-16 Export crosses the wrong boundary
threats.description: T-16: A share export could include leads, owner-only fields, hostile assets, or identifying metadata.
threats.mitigation: T-16: Reuse a named audience projection and manifest, provide no store handle, and test sentinel leads across every output.

threats.title: T-55 and T-56 PDF renderer fetches or interprets hostile content
threats.description: T-55 and T-56: Remote loads or hostile markup could disclose network details or steer the renderer.
threats.mitigation: T-55 and T-56: src/reach_around seals and rebuilds PDF input and blocks requests; tests/test_kit_pdf_pipeline.py and tests/test_kit_pdf_hardening.py verify the controls.

threats.title: T-58 and T-59 PDF leak check misses private text
threats.description: T-58 and T-59: A stale page or unsupported PDF structure could hide private text from the leak check.
threats.mitigation: T-58 and T-59: src/reach_around fails closed and verifies extracted and required text; tests/test_kit_pdf_text.py, tests/test_kit_pdf_hardening.py, and tests/test_kit_pdf_pipeline.py cover failures.

threats.title: T-60 PDF metadata identifies owner or machine
threats.description: T-60: PDF or image metadata, producer strings, user names, or paths could identify the machine.
threats.mitigation: T-60: src/reach_around rewrites and strips metadata; tests/test_kit_pdf_pipeline.py and tests/test_kit_pdf_jpeg.py verify it.

threats.title: T-62 PDF leftovers or unbounded resource use
threats.description: T-62: An intermediate, profile, hung render, or oversized output could remain or exhaust resources.
threats.mitigation: T-62: src/reach_around uses private work areas, cleanup, timeout, and caps; tests/test_kit_pdf_pipeline.py and tests/test_kit_pdf_hardening.py verify them.

threats.title: T-57 PDF asset path escapes confinement
threats.description: T-57: A path, link, special file, or oversized file could read beyond staged static files.
threats.mitigation: T-57: src/reach_around uses confined no-follow capped reads; tests/test_kit_pdf_hardening.py and tests/test_kit_pdf_output.py cover them.

threats.title: T-61 PDF is written into a publishable location
threats.description: T-61: A private PDF could enter a site, configuration, gated, or version-controlled tree, or follow a link.
threats.mitigation: T-61: src/reach_around confines and atomically writes output; tests/test_kit_pdf_output.py covers paths, links, modes, and overwrite.

data.name: TB10 Browser origins
data.description: Untrusted pages and the editor and preview origins are separate.

label.text: TB11 Local editor process and files

data.name: TB11 Local editor process and files
data.description: The local process mediates access to owner files.

data.name: Visited web page
data.description: A page or extension that can reach loopback.

data.name: Editor browser tab
data.description: Holds the session token and renders owner-controlled text.

threats.title: T-24 Session token leakage
threats.description: T-24: The per-session token could remain visible in browser or operating-system surfaces.
threats.mitigation: T-24: Fragment delivery, memory-only storage, and response checks are shipped, but browser verification that the token leaves the address bar and storage is still proposed.

threats.title: T-30 Editor clickjacking controls
threats.description: T-30: another page could frame the editor and trick the owner into changing content.
threats.mitigation: T-30: src/reach_around/editor/server.py sends frame-ancestors none and X-Frame-Options DENY on every editor response, and the preview origin allows framing only by the editor; tests/editor/test_csp.py (test_every_editor_response_has_the_hardening_headers, test_preview_listener_is_sandboxed_and_only_the_editor_may_frame_it) verify them. The second confirmation for destructive actions arrives with the forms and is tracked in docs/security/threat-model.md.

threats.title: T-32 Config text executes in the editor
threats.description: T-32: Owner-controlled or shared config text could execute in the privileged editor page.
threats.mitigation: T-32: src/reach_around/editor_assets uses text-only rendering and a closed CSP; tests/editor/test_sources.py and tests/editor/test_csp.py verify dangerous sinks and unsafe directives are absent.

threats.title: T-33 Editor front-end supply chain
threats.description: T-33: A remote or missing front-end dependency could execute with editor authority.
threats.mitigation: T-33: editor assets are local same-folder modules with no remote URLs; tests/editor/test_sources.py verifies imports, references, and the no-remote rule.

data.name: Loopback editor server
data.description: Authenticates requests and applies bounded edits.

threats.title: T-22 DNS rebinding and non-loopback reach
threats.description: T-22: A hostile page could reach the editor through DNS rebinding or a non-loopback bind.
threats.mitigation: T-22: src/reach_around/editor restricts binding, Host, Origin, and tokens; tests/editor/test_guard.py and tests/editor/test_server_lifecycle.py verify those controls.

threats.title: T-23 Cross-origin state change
threats.description: T-23: A cross-origin request could change the owner's configuration.
threats.mitigation: T-23: src/reach_around/editor requires a token, JSON content type, matching Origin, and POST for changes; tests/editor/test_guard.py and tests/editor/test_routes.py verify refusals leave files unchanged.

threats.title: T-25 Editor resource exhaustion
threats.description: T-25: Oversized, slow, malformed, or frequent requests could exhaust memory, workers, history, or disk.
threats.mitigation: T-25: JSON, header, connection, timeout, mutation, and history caps are tested, but upload and media-count controls remain planned.

threats.title: T-31 Local process or extension access
threats.description: T-31: A same-user process or privileged browser extension could reach the editor or steal its token.
threats.mitigation: T-31: the token is process-local and is not placed in argv or environment; tests/editor/test_server_lifecycle.py verifies the shipped exposure limits. Same-user compromise remains residual risk.

threats.title: T-35 Editor logging disclosure
threats.description: T-35: Logs could disclose tokens or owner content.
threats.mitigation: T-35: the editor does not emit request or config content; tests/editor/test_server_lifecycle.py verifies a real session does not print the token.

threats.title: T-36 Forgotten live editor session
threats.description: T-36: The authenticated local server could remain available after the owner leaves.
threats.mitigation: T-36: clean shutdown is tested, but the planned idle timeout, page exit control, and visible session state are not all shipped.

data.name: Config, history, and media
data.description: Owner files read and written by the editor.

threats.title: T-26 Editor path and symlink escape
threats.description: T-26: A path, link, or special file could escape the config, history, or future media folders.
threats.mitigation: T-26: descriptor-relative config and history controls are tested, but editor media confinement and save-time asset hooks remain unbuilt.

threats.title: T-27 Hostile editor uploads
threats.description: T-27: A future upload could disguise active content, exhaust resources, overwrite a file, or disclose metadata.
threats.mitigation: T-27: the asset content checks exist, but the upload route, generated-name write controls, dimension cap, and editor upload tests are planned.

threats.title: T-28 Unsafe or raced YAML write
threats.description: T-28: An edit could corrupt YAML, lose unrelated text, race another writer, or leave a partial file.
threats.mitigation: T-28: src/reach_around/editing.py uses checked text splices, locks, identity checks, staging, and atomic replacement; tests/test_edit.py and tests/test_edit_durability.py verify the controls.

threats.title: T-29 Editor secret disclosure
threats.description: T-29: The state response or a future media listing could disclose extra config fields or neighboring secret files.
threats.mitigation: T-29: no debug or environment route exists, but state is not schema-allowlisted and the proposed sentinel and media-listing tests do not exist.

threats.title: T-34 Preview iframe escape
threats.description: T-34: Preview content could reach the editor, its token, or unintended network destinations.
threats.mitigation: T-34: separate origins and frame sandboxing are partly shipped, but the real preview, navigation policy, and browser isolation tests remain proposed.
